issues.where: the orbital reveal, from about 2:49 to 3:14
issues.what: Once the whole body is readable, the camera drifts through nearly the same composition for roughly 25 seconds, making the ending linger and pushing the runtime to about 3:18.
issues.fix: Keep the uninterrupted rise and full-body reveal, then hold the settled wide briefly and end closer to three minutes.

issues.what: After the opening push, the view jumps from the near spire to a wider look back at the approach, then to the next spires and inside the cave. The route into the cave stops reading as one camera journey.
issues.fix: Keep the cave as the destination through the push and carry the camera across the threshold without resetting to a different viewpoint.

issues.what: The lake is framed as a thin horizontal strip and too much of the image is given to flat foreground. The target gives the basin substantially more depth in frame.
issues.fix: Raise the opening viewpoint and angle it down enough to give the lake more vertical room while retaining the right overhang and foreground shore.
